# Native-lane request corpus: the programs of the native-wave2 / native-wave3
# checkpoints and of the native admission requests, run on native-lane-v1.
# Driven by tests/native_lane_request_fixtures.rs. One record per program:
#
#   === <id> | <expect> | red=<3|-> | <default|bounded> | <origin>
#   <MIND source, up to the next `===` line>
#
# expect:
#   exit=N        the native artifact and the MLIR artifact both build and exit N
#                 with identical stdout
#   parity        both build; exits and stdout are equal (the value is owned by
#                 another contract and is not pinned here)
#   refused=TEXT  the native build exits 3, writes nothing and names TEXT
#   defect=WHY    native-lane-v1 builds it and the result differs from MLIR; the
#                 ignored open-defect test requires a named refusal or parity
# red=3: a pre-lane compiler refuses the program with exit 3 (the RED leg).
# The corpus is plain text, not `.mind` files, so the front-end differential
# corpus under tests/fixtures (G2) does not pick up these deliberately
# ill-typed and duplicate-declaration programs.

=== w1_io_shape | exit=73 | red=3 | default | native-wave2 checkpoint (38cc419b) tests/native_intrinsic_std_linkage.rs::the_memory_and_io_intrinsics_build_and_run
fn fill(p: i64, n: i64) -> i64 {
    let mut i: i64 = 0;
    while i < n {
        __mind_store_i8(p + i, 65 + i);
        i = i + 1;
    }
    0
}

fn main() -> i64 {
    let p: i64 = __mind_alloc(32);
    fill(p, 4);
    __mind_store_i8(p + 4, 10);
    let mut sent: i64 = 0;
    while sent < 5 {
        let n: i64 = __mind_write(1, p + sent, 5 - sent, 0 - 1);
        sent = sent + n;
    }
    __mind_store_i64(p + 8, 1000);
    let q: i64 = __mind_realloc(p, 64);
    let kept: i64 = __mind_load_i64(q + 8) + __mind_load_i8(q + 3);
    let freed: i64 = __mind_free(q);
    return kept - 1000 + sent + freed;
}

=== w1_narrow | refused=native-lane-v1 (lane.call.unknown) | red=3 | default | native-wave2 checkpoint (38cc419b) tests/native_intrinsic_std_linkage.rs::narrow_memory_and_wrap_intrinsics_build_and_run
fn main() -> i64 {
    let p: i64 = __mind_alloc(16);
    __mind_store_i64(p, 0 - 1);
    __mind_store_i16(p, 70000);
    __mind_store_i32(p + 8, 0 - 2);
    let a: i64 = __mind_load_i16(p);
    let b: i64 = __mind_load_i32(p + 8);
    let w: i64 = __mind_wrap_i8(300) + __mind_wrap_i16(65535) + __mind_wrap_i32(4294967297);
    if a != 4464 { return 1; }
    if b != 4294967294 { return 2; }
    if __mind_load_i8(p + 2) != 255 { return 3; }
    return w + 100;
}

=== w1_alloc_negative | defect=alloc size <= 0: native returns an arena pointer, the C runtime returns 0 | red=3 | default | native-wave2 checkpoint (38cc419b) tests/native_intrinsic_std_linkage.rs::an_alloc_size_not_proven_positive_is_refused

=== w1_bad_fd | parity | red=3 | default | native-wave2 checkpoint (38cc419b) tests/native_intrinsic_std_linkage.rs::io_error_results_match_the_mlir_backend (the I/O failure value (-1 today on both backends) is not pinned here)

=== w1_null_and_empty | refused=native-lane-v1 (lane.call.unknown) | red=3 | default | native-wave2 checkpoint (38cc419b) tests/native_intrinsic_std_linkage.rs::io_error_results_match_the_mlir_backend
fn main() -> i64 {
    let path: i64 = __mind_alloc(16);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 0, 47);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 1, 100);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 2, 101);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 3, 118);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 4, 47);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 5, 122);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 6, 101);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 7, 114);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 8, 111);
    __mind_store_i8(path + 9, 0);
    let fd: i64 = __mind_open(path);
    if fd < 3 {
        return 1;
    }
    let buf: i64 = __mind_alloc(8);
    let a: i64 = __mind_read(fd, 0, 8, 0 - 1);
    let b: i64 = __mind_write(99, buf, 0, 0 - 1);
    let c: i64 = __mind_write(1, buf, 0 - 5, 0 - 1);
    let d: i64 = if c < 0 { 0 } else { 50 };
    return 200 + a + b * 2 + d;
}

    let p: i64 = __mind_alloc(64);
    __mind_store_i8(p, 42);
    __mind_store_i16(p + 8, 1234);
    __mind_store_i32(p + 16, 567890);
    __mind_store_i64(p + 24, 9876543210);
    let v8: i64 = __mind_load_i8(p);
    let v16: i64 = __mind_load_i16(p + 8);

    let v64: i64 = __mind_load_i64(p + 24);

    if v32 != 567890 { return 3; }
    if v64 != 9876543210 { return 4; }
    0
}

=== a_ct_eq_shape | exit=101 | red=3 | default | native intrinsic admission request: R-09 ct_eq shape (alloc + load_i8 + >>)
fn ct_eq(a: i64, b: i64, n: i64) -> i64 {
    let mut acc: i64 = 0;
    let mut i: i64 = 0;
    while i < n {
        acc = acc | (__mind_load_i8(a + i) ^ __mind_load_i8(b + i));
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return ((acc - 1) >> 63) & 1;
}

fn main() -> i64 {
    let a: i64 = __mind_alloc(16);
    let b: i64 = __mind_alloc(16);
    let mut i: i64 = 0;
    while i < 16 {
        __mind_store_i8(a + i, 200 + i);
        __mind_store_i8(b + i, 200 + i);
        i = i + 1;
    }
    let same: i64 = ct_eq(a, b, 16);
    __mind_store_i8(b + 15, 1);
    let differ: i64 = ct_eq(a, b, 16);
    let none: i64 = ct_eq(a, b, 0);
    return same * 100 + differ * 10 + none;
}

=== e_value_if_in_while | exit=0 | red=3 | default | value-if inside while request: native_hkdf_loop_probe.mind (std/tls13-client-r01)
// Reduced from std/hkdf.mind: hkdf_expand's value-if inside a loop.
fn main() -> i64 {
    let mut written: i64 = 0;
    let mut i: i64 = 1;
    while i <= 1 {
        let remaining: i64 = 32 - written;
        let tocopy: i64 = if remaining < 32 { remaining } else { 32 };
        written = written + tocopy;
        i = i + 1;
    }
    written - 32
}

fn find(n: i64) -> i64 {
    let mut i: i64 = 0;
    let mut total: i64 = 0;
    while i < n {
        let step: i64 = if i == 7 { return total + 100; } else { i };

    }
    total
}

}

=== e_value_if_while_in_if | exit=120 | red=3 | default | value-if inside while request: shape 6: if-value inside while inside if
fn vif_steps(flag: i64) -> i64 {
    let mut s: i64 = 0;
    if flag > 0 {
        let mut i: i64 = 0;
        while i < 4 {
            let d: i64 = if i < flag { 5 } else { 1 };
            s = s + d;
            i = i + 1;
        }
    }
    s
}

fn main() -> i64 {
    vif_steps(2) * 10 + vif_steps(0)
}
